# composition-quality-checker (reference summary)

## Purpose
Validate camera framing, subject placement, headroom/lead-room, and visual hierarchy against the scene brief before render.

Run a focused per-row Pass/Warn/Fail check on the camera and framing setup against composition rules (rule of thirds, subject placement, headroom/lead-room, negative space, visual hierarchy, depth cues, and lens/FOV plausibility) — emitting per-row verdicts, a top-line status, and remediation hints only, without expanding into camera planning, aspect-ratio locking, material validation, or lighting validation.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/composition-quality-checker/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/composition-quality-checker/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `quality-validators` / `framing-and-silhouette-validator`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- before render
- after a camera change request
- as a sub-check during full quality review
- when a render "feels off" but lighting and materials check out

## Trigger cues
- "is the framing okay"
- "check composition"
- "subject feels off-center"
- "too much negative space"

## When not to use
- planning or editing camera framing → delegate to `blender-composition-camera-planner` (`references/skills/blender-composition-camera-planner.md`; use blender-composition-camera-planner)
- locking aspect ratio or resolution → delegate to `resolution-aspect-decision` (`references/skills/resolution-aspect-decision.md`; use resolution-aspect-decision)
- material validation → delegate to `material-quality-checker` (`references/skills/material-quality-checker.md`; use material-quality-checker)
- lighting validation → delegate to `lighting-quality-checker` (`references/skills/lighting-quality-checker.md`; use lighting-quality-checker)
- broad scene Pass/Warn/Fail readiness review → delegate to `blender-scene-quality-checker` (`references/skills/blender-scene-quality-checker.md`; use blender-scene-quality-checker)
- classifying render or export artifact evidence → delegate to `render-export-evidence` (`references/skills/render-export-evidence.md`; use render-export-evidence)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `camera_and_framing_spec` (`object`): Camera focal length, sensor, angle, and subject placement from blender-composition-camera-planner
- `pinned_aspect_ratio_and_subject` (`object`): Locked aspect ratio and primary/secondary focal hierarchy from brief

### Optional inputs
- `viewport_or_render_preview_notes` (`string`): Optional framing observations from a viewport or preview capture

### Primary outputs
- `composition_verdict_table`
- `silhouette_and_headroom_assessment`
- `camera_replan_remediation_hints`

## Quick-start procedure
1. read camera lens / FOV, position, and target description
2. read framing intent and locked aspect ratio from the brief
3. check rule of thirds, subject placement, and headroom/lead-room
4. check negative space, visual hierarchy, depth cues, and lens/FOV plausibility
5. emit per-row Pass/Warn/Fail verdicts, top-line status, and remediation hints (keep truth states separate and downgrade-only)

## Handoff notes

- **[retry]** Aspect ratio & resolution locks → `resolution-aspect-decision` (`references/skills/resolution-aspect-decision.md`) (max retry attempts: 2)
- **[progression]** Artifact evidence classification → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skills/render-export-evidence.md`)

- **[upstream_reference]** Lighting validation → `lighting-quality-checker` (`references/skills/lighting-quality-checker.md`)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** This skill validates camera plans or measured scene snapshots only. It never moves the camera, never runs Blender, and never executes Python. Artifacts stay `Not Produced` unless concrete output evidence exists (classified by `render-export-evidence`), and truth states are strictly downgrade-only.
- Move or edit the camera (owned by `blender-composition-camera-planner`).
- Lock aspect ratio or resolution (owned by `resolution-aspect-decision`).
- Validate materials (`material-quality-checker`) or lighting (`lighting-quality-checker`).
- Replace broad scene review (`blender-scene-quality-checker`).
- Classify render or export artifact evidence (`render-export-evidence`).
- Run Blender or execute Python.
